_note: Provenance of the uk local words of the ClayArena glossary (docs/glossary/data/i18n/uk.js): src = the page the word was taken from, note = the editor's note. Moved out of docs/ on 09.10.2026 so the published glossary files carry no source addresses or editor notes (some named other disciplines or other federations; owner rule: Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting only, no other federation named). Not published, not read by the build. Edit together with the term in i18n/uk.js.

adjustable-comb.note: Both forms heard; «регульована щока» common in shop specs.

barrel-length.note: Shops give cm (71/76/81 см); coaches often say inches.

battue.note: Spelling unsettled: clubs write «Бату», project glossary «батю».

bead.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

blazed-target.note: Descriptive (no source): the Ukrainian rules only say targets must be coloured. 05.11.2026.

bolting-rabbit.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

cage.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

call.note: Rules: targets «викликані спортсменом», «попросити мішень». The spoken call word varies by shooter.

canting.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

cartridge.note: Both are standard Ukrainian; the Ukrainian competition rules use «патрон», shops and clubs often «набої».

cast.note: No settled Ukrainian term; interpreters often keep «cast» and explain.

chandelle.note: Англійська назва на майданчику; зазвичай кажуть англійською. Не плутати з французьким «chandelle» (= teal).

checking.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

chip.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

choke.note: «Чок» is universal; «дульне звуження» is the technical term.

clock-face.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

comb.note: Coaches often say «щока» for the cheek area / adjustable comb.

consecutive-interpreting.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

double-on-report.note: The Ukrainian Sporting Federation translation of the FITASC Compak® Sporting rules (§3.3.1) names it «сигнальний дуплет»; «дуплет на постріл» is also heard.

ejector.note: Do not confuse with «екстрактор» (only pushes the case out).

extended-choke.note: Usage uncertain; shops also write «зовнішній чок».

false-friend.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

fibre-wad.note: Mostly a shop term; usage not well documented.

fixed-choke.note: Usage varies; meaning: choke machined into the barrel.

follow-through.note: In the Academy «проводка» is the swing itself, so it is not used for the follow-through.

fore-end.note: Universal; same word in catalogues and on the range.

gauge.note: Said as «12-й калібр»; chamber length added as 12/70, 12/76.

global-dro.note: Service name, not translated; local word = what it is. 05.11.2026.

gun-mount.note: Rules: «підняти рушницю до плеча»; verb «вкладати / вкласти рушницю». One term everywhere: «вкладка».

gun-up.note: Ukrainian Compak® Sporting rules 2026 (USF), 17.5.2: the gun may be «вкладена в плече або ні» when the target is called. Checked 05.11.2026.

hand-signal.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

hang-fire.note: «Осічка» = no shot at all (misfire), not hang fire.

hard-case.note: Rules: «закритий футляр для зброї»; on ranges «кейс».

hearing-protection.note: Rules: «навушники, вушні затички або інші засоби захисту вух».

improved-cylinder.note: Range talk uses fractions («чверть»); written sources split between «покращений» and «модифікований» циліндр.

improved-modified.note: Fractions dominate in speech; written forms vary.

jury.note: National rules use «ГСК» (головна суддівська колегія) for the organizing panel.

late-mount.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

load-weight.note: «Наважка», as in the official translation of the rules; loads are also named by grams: «24-ка», «28-ка». The older spelling with «-віс-» is not used.

looper.note: The Academy writes «лупер, або дуга»; not a chandelle: names vary between countries.

maintained-lead.note: Усталеного українського терміна немає; стрільці часто кажуть англійською.

manual-release.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

miss-behind.note: Where the shot went, as coaches say it; the words of the Academy lessons (faults, follow-through).

miss-in-front.note: Where the shot went, as coaches say it; the words of the Academy lessons (faults, follow-through).

miss-over.note: Where the shot went, as coaches say it; the words of the Academy lessons (faults, follow-through).

miss-under.note: Where the shot went, as coaches say it; the words of the Academy lessons (faults, follow-through).

mock-shooting.note: Official Ukrainian rules also say «холосте прицілювання».

move-mount-shoot.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

no-bird.note: Owner decision: the referee's call stays English «No Bird» in every language, with a short local explanation (uk: «мішень повторюють»). The official Ukrainian command «НЕМАЄ МІШЕНІ» is kept as alt.

one.note: Owner decision: uk «влучання»; the referee's call stays as it is said on the stand («one», «dead»). Rules: «уражена мішень».

over-and-under.note: «Вертикалка» is the range word; catalogues use the long form.

poking.note: Descriptive (no source): name of a fault in English coaching. 05.11.2026.

pull-away.note: Усталеного українського терміна немає; стрільці часто кажуть англійською.

pump-action.note: The Ukrainian competition rules exclude «помпові» guns; colloquially «помпа».

quiet-eye.note: Research term; the Academy writes «тихе око» (quiet eye).

rabbit.note: Owner decision (07.10.2026): «заєць», as the target is called in Ukraine; «кролик» is kept only as a search alias.

receiver.note: «Колодка» for break-action guns; «ствольна коробка» for semi-autos.

recoil-pad.note: Both «затильник» and «потиличник» appear in shop specs.

recovery.note: Descriptive (no source): element of technique in English coaching. 05.11.2026.

refusal-to-comply.note: Owner decision: «відмова виконувати вимоги судді» (not «відмова підкорятися»).

riding-the-target.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

shell-catcher.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

shooting-stand.note: Ukrainian FITASC rules 2026 (USF), Sporting 2.4 «Стрілецькі місця обмежуються квадратом зі стороною 1 м». For the stations of Compak® Sporting always «номер» (owner decision), never «місце». Checked 05.11.2026.

shotgun.note: Official rules: «гладкоствольні рушниці». Colloquially shooters also say «ствол».

show-clear.note: Ukrainian FITASC rules 2026 (USF): «відкрити рушницю»; Compak safety: «Рушниці слід переносити у відкритому вигляді та розряженими». Checked 05.11.2026.

side-by-side.note: Rare on sporting ranges; mostly a hunting gun.

simultaneous-double.note: Ukrainian FITASC rules 2026 (USF), Sporting 4.2.2 «Синхронний дуплет», Compak 3.3.2. Checked 05.11.2026.

smoked-it.note: Descriptive (no source: coaching slang). NOT «мішень пилила / димить»: in the Ukrainian rules that is a ZERO (dust only, no piece). 05.11.2026.

sonopull.note: Rules: «система електронного мікрофона»; brand name used colloquially.

squad.note: Owner decision: uk «група»; the English word «squad» is not used in Ukrainian texts.

stance.note: Rules speak of «положення ніг на номері».

swing-through.note: Усталеного українського терміна немає; стрільці часто кажуть англійською.

target-line.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

teal.note: Some shooters call the vertical riser «свічка»; overlaps with springing.

tempo.note: Ordinary Ukrainian word: «Ступінь швидкості, здійснення, виконання…» (explanatory dictionary). Checked 05.11.2026.

top-lever.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

tower.note: «Вишка» is the usual word; «тауер» is a loan from English.

transition.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

trap.note: Rules use both «метальна» and «пускова машинка»; on the range just «машинка».

wad.note: Plastic one-piece wad is usually called «контейнер».

waiting-position.note: Added 09.10.2026 (handover) from the words the Ukrainian lessons already use for this term; conf low until a Ukrainian editor confirms it.

zero.note: Owner decision: uk «промах»; the referee's call stays as it is said on the stand («zero», «lost»). Rules: команда «ПРОМАХ».
